I am an old woman with no schooling, and I have been farming this small rented land for many years. Here in the South South, the rains are plentiful for my root crops, so I do not need to buy fertilizer or irrigate. I keep my own cassava cuttings from the last harvest, and my children and grandchildren will come to help with the planting, weeding, and harvesting. I have no money to waste on chemicals or hired hands when we can do the work ourselves.
